description: Claims-system write API misses the cutover window
contingency: Launch read-only assistance and defer protected writes

description: Cross-tenant authorization defect appears in staging
contingency: Hold promotion and repair tenant enforcement

description: Policy metadata is incomplete for a pilot jurisdiction
trigger: Coverage falls below 100 percent for pilot policies
contingency: Remove affected jurisdiction from cohort and repair metadata

description: Adjuster training completion falls below 90 percent
trigger: Completion below target three days before cutover
contingency: Reduce cohort to trained adjusters and add office hours

description: p95 latency exceeds 12 seconds in staging load test
trigger: Two consecutive windows exceed the SLO
contingency: Tune retrieval limit concurrency and timeouts

description: Executive sponsor requests enterprise rollout before pilot evidence
trigger: Request exceeds cohort volume or duration boundary
contingency: Require a new scope decision and release review

description: On-call coverage is incomplete for the first weekend
trigger: Any severity-one slot lacks primary and backup
contingency: Delay go-live or add approved coverage

description: Managed model endpoint has a regional service disruption
trigger: Provider health alert or circuit breaker opens
contingency: Disable AI assistance and continue manual claims handling
